Guest * -> 1 GenderA Gender has some Guests. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.A Guest has A Gender. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Gender.When a Guest is created, its Gender must be assigned. When a Guest is deleted, its Gender is not deleted and its list of Guests is decreased. When a Gender is deleted, its Guests are not deleted. They are assigned to another Gender.
